description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Generic LCO 18650 cell (LiCoO2 cathode, graphite anode)
cell.source: Reimers & Dahn (1992), J. Electrochem. Soc. 139, 2091; consumer-electronics LCO datasheets

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref (298.15 K); LCO has higher impedance than NMC due to ordered layered structure

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative LCO discharge curve; Reimers & Dahn (1992)

E_a.note: Activation energy for LCO internal resistance; LCO has higher E_a than NMC due to less thermally stable layered oxide
E_a.source: Jalkanen et al. (2015), Applied Energy 154, 160-172; Forgez et al. (2010), J. Power Sources 195, 2961

alpha_c.note: Linear capacity temperature coefficient for LCO
alpha_c.source: Schmalstieg et al. (2014), J. Power Sources 257, 325-334

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for LCO graphite cell; slightly larger than NMC due to ordered LiCoO2 phase transitions
dOCV_dT.source: Thomas & Newman (2003), J. Electrochem. Soc. 150(2), A176-A192

temperature.note: 0 to 45 degC; LCO normal Li-ion operating range
